title: A radiographic world model for clinical reasoning and evidence generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating diagnostic classification performance (weighted F1 scores and false-negative rates) across racial subgroups (Asian, Black, White) on held-out real images to measure subgroup diagnostic errors and assess the impact of metadata-guided synthetic data rebalancing.

Evaluating diagnostic classification performance (weighted F1 scores and false-negative rates) across gender subgroups (Female, Male) on held-out real images to measure subgroup diagnostic errors and assess the impact of metadata-guided synthetic data rebalancing.

Evaluating diagnostic classification performance (weighted F1 scores and false-negative rates) across different age groups (19-40, 41-65, 66+) on held-out real images to measure subgroup diagnostic errors and assess the impact of metadata-guided synthetic data rebalancing.
